structure: Iowa Academic Standards for Social Studies (January 2026), one PDF. Front matter (cover, contents, introduction and six guiding principles, organization/scope-and-sequence overview table, standards architecture and coding diagram, anchor table, 'Connections' explanation) precedes the standards. K-8 are organized by grade (K 'Me and My Communities', 1 'Places Near and Far', 2 'Our State', 3 'America's Early Story', 4 'Our New Nation', 5 'Our Changing Nation', 6 'Ancient/Medieval World Studies', 7 'Modern World Studies' organized by world region, 8 'U.S. History and Civics'); each grade opens with a title and a narrative paragraph, an 'Inquiry Standards' table (SS.<grade>.1-5 or similar), then topic sections (e.g. 'I Belong', 'Financial Literacy' topics) each with its own table. 9-12 is one band organized by discipline/course: shared 'Inquiry Standards' (SS.9-12.1-8, apply to all HS courses), then Civics/Government (SS.9-12.Gov.n), Economics (Econ.n), Financial Literacy (FL.n), Geography (Geo.n), U.S. History (US.n), World History (WH.n), and elective Psychology (Psy.n) and Sociology (Soc.n); each discipline has a title, a narrative overview paragraph and topic sections with tables. Standards tables have three columns (C1 'Anchor' = inquiry practice or discipline strand label, e.g. 'History: Multiple Perspectives'; C2 'Standard' = coded standard statement; C3 'Disciplinary Content or Practice Clarification' = 'May include / Must include' lists and examples); Psychology and Sociology tables have two columns (C1 Standard, C2 Clarification, no Anchor). Column cells are extracted as separate fragments (a multi-line cell is split into several units interleaved with the other columns), so units were labeled by column index: C1 and C2 = standards, C3 / clarification column = examples, header row R1 = backup. Below each table: cross-curricular reference blocks ('Literacy', 'Mathematics', 'Science' with CCSS/NGSS codes; labeled backup), 'Iowa Connection' paragraphs and 'Career Connection' lists (their icon labels were not extracted; labeled examples by content). Grade 7 'Financial Literacy' etc. are topic sections within a grade (course null). Appendix: CCSS literacy in history/social studies (RH, WHST; backup), Global Regions list (referenced by grade 7), and Sources.
